title: When the Terminal Breaks Revisited
author: Petra Nakamura
blurb: Kestrel Reyes, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
